name: EA Stochastic
summary: This EA trades based on the Stochastic oscillator, entering positions when the indicator signals overbought or oversold conditions. It opens buy trades when Stochastic crosses upward from oversold zones and sell trades when it crosses downward from overbought zones. The strategy targets mean reversion opportunities in ranging or moderating markets.
summary_zh: 该EA基于随机指标(Stochastic)进行交易，当指标显示超买或超卖信号时开仓。在Stochastic从超卖区域向上交叉时买入，从超买区域向下交叉时卖出。该策略针对震荡或回调行情中的均值回归机会。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是基于随机指标(Stochastic)的均值回归交易，利用%K线和%D线的交叉以及超买超卖区域来判断入场时机。入场条件为：%K线从超卖区域(通常低于20)向上穿越%D线时开多单，%K线从超买区域(通常高于80)向下穿越%D线时开空单。出场条件通常包括固定止盈和止损，或者当Stochastic回到中性区域时平仓。仓位管理方面，EA允许用户设置固定手数或基于资金比例的仓位计算方式。资金管理方面，该EA依赖Stochastic指标固有的均值回归特性，但在强趋势市场中可能面临连续亏损的风险，因为随机指标在趋势行情中会长时间停留在超买或超卖区域。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept is mean reversion trading based on the Stochastic oscillator, utilizing %K and %D line crossovers along with overbought and oversold zones to determine entry timing. Entry conditions are: open a long position when the %K line crosses above the %D line from the oversold zone (typically below 20), and open a short position when the %K line crosses below the %D line from the overbought zone (typically above 80). Exit conditions typically include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, or closing positions when the Stochastic returns to neutral territory. Position sizing allows the user to set fixed lot sizes or calculate position size based on a percentage of account equity. Money management relies on the Stochastic indicator's inherent mean reversion characteristic, but the strategy faces the risk of consecutive losses in strong trending markets since the Stochastic can remain in overbought or oversold zones for extended periods during trends.

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰,基于经典的随机指标超买超卖原理,易于理解和验证
使用Stochastic交叉信号作为入场依据,相比单一阈值信号减少了假信号
参数可配置性强,用户可以根据不同品种和周期调整K/D周期和超买超卖阈值
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic based on the classic Stochastic overbought/oversold principle, easy to understand and verify
Uses Stochastic crossover signals for entry, reducing false signals compared to single threshold triggers
Highly configurable parameters allowing users to adjust K/D periods and overbought/oversold thresholds for different instruments and timeframes
cons: 均值回归策略在强趋势市场中表现不佳,Stochastic会长时间停留在超买超卖区域导致反复亏损
缺乏趋势过滤器,无法区分震荡行情和趋势行情,在趋势中容易逆势交易
默认止损止盈为零,存在无止损运行的极大风险,可能导致巨额亏损
cons_en: Mean reversion strategy performs poorly in strong trending markets as the Stochastic can remain in overbought/oversold zones for extended periods causing repeated losses
Lacks a trend filter to distinguish between ranging and trending markets, prone to counter-trend trading during trends
Default stop-loss and take-profit are zero, presenting extreme risk of running without protective stops which could lead to catastrophic losses
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器(如ADX或均线方向),仅在震荡行情中交易均值回归信号,趋势行情中暂停交易
添加强制止损机制,确保每笔交易都有合理的止损保护,避免无止损裸露风险
增加新K线检查机制,避免在同一根K线上重复开仓,以及添加点差过滤防止高滑点入场
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (such as ADX or moving average direction) to only trade mean reversion signals in ranging markets and pause trading during trending markets
Implement mandatory stop-loss mechanism to ensure every trade has reasonable stop-loss protection, avoiding the risk of unprotected positions
Add new bar check to prevent repeated entries on the same bar, and add spread filter to prevent entries during high spread conditions

risk_points: 默认止损止盈为零,交易可能无任何保护地无限亏损
缺乏趋势过滤机制,在强趋势行情中会逆势反复开仓导致连续亏损
未明确是否有新K线检查,可能在同一根K线上多次开仓导致过度持仓
risk_points_en: Default stop-loss and take-profit are zero, trades can incur unlimited losses without any protection
Lacks trend filter mechanism, will repeatedly open counter-trend positions during strong trends leading to consecutive losses
No explicit new bar check, may open multiple positions on the same bar leading to excessive exposure
